name: Portal Hub H2-45-101
type: Local Fairy Door hub with surface access shaft
description: Within the broad hawthorn's trunk, a narrow door opens onto a ladder descending between the roots. The shaft emerges through the central pillar of a bright circular chamber, surrounded by blue-lit portals beneath individual emblems. Pale flooring and gold-edged arches give the hidden room an unexpected elegance; deeper still, a luminous sphere rests in its own enclosed well.
atmosphere: Bark and earth give way to smooth, cool surfaces. The ladder creaks above a quiet mechanical hum, and blue light reaches up the shaft towards the daylight.
notes: A local hub connected on the map to Portal Hub H2-45-99. The trunk door and ladder provide a physical surface entrance, distinct from the Fairy Doors around the chamber. Concealment and access security keep the entrance from being an obvious public shortcut. The vertical approach lets a first-time visitor discover the underground room gradually. The sphere below is facility apparatus, not another walk-through exit.
